of the United States of America, it is hereby ordered that Executive Order 
12866 of September 30, 1993, as amended, is further amended as follows:

(such as externalities, market power, lack of information) or other specific

of public institutions) that warrant new agency action, as well as assess 
the significance of that problem, to enable assessment of whether any 
new regulation is warranted.’’

document’’.

guidance documents’’.

status_research.rationale: I read the complete held EO 13422 (72 FR 2763, Jan. 18, 2007, 'Further Amendment to Executive Order 12866 on Regulatory Planning and Review'): it amends EO 12866 (policy statement and definitions of 'guidance document', significant guidance, regulatory plan and OIRA review; creation of Regulatory Policy Officers and their role); it is an amending order with no own term and no savings clause. I read the complete held EO 13497 (74 FR 6113, Jan. 30, 2009, 'Revocation of Certain Executive Orders Concerning Regulatory Planning and Review'): sec. 1 provides 'Executive Order 13258 of February 26, 2002, and Executive Order 13422 of January 18, 2007, concerning regulatory planning and review, which amended Executive Order 12866 of September 30, 1993, are revoked'; sec. 2 directs OMB and agencies to rescind implementing orders and guidance 'to the extent consistent with law'; sec. 3 is a no-private-right clause. The revocation names EO 13422 by number with no exception, delay or savings clause, so the whole order ended on Jan. 30, 2009 (the machine ACT scope 'partial' reflects that the sentence also names EO 13258, not any limit on 13422). D6 self-check, each later event: EO 13777 (2017) and EO 14215 (2025) amend or cite EO 12866 'as amended' but do not mention EO 13422 and do not restore its text (EO 14215 sec. 3(b) re-words the 'agency' definition of EO 12866); EO 14219 (Feb. 19, 2025, the catalog 'See' lead) uses the term 'guidance document' 'as defined in Executive Order 13422' in its own definitions, which borrows a definition by reference inside a new order and neither re-enacts nor revives EO 13422's commands; the held text of EO 14219 contains no other reference. I found no earlier own-term ending and no instrument between 2007 and 2009 amending EO 13422. Provisional NO hypothesis only.

record.rationale: Independent reading: held EO 13422 (72 FR 2763, Jan. 18, 2007) amends EO 12866 (guidance documents, Regulatory Policy Officers); no own term. Held EO 13497 (74 FR 6113, Jan. 30, 2009) sec. 1: 'Executive Order 13258 ... and Executive Order 13422 of January 18, 2007 ... are revoked'; sec. 2 rescission of implementing guidance; no savings clause. Express by-number whole revocation; independent status NO, agrees. Refutation: ACT scope 'partial' reflects the two-order sentence, not a limit on EO 13422. D6: EO 13777 and EO 14215 amend or cite EO 12866 and do not restore EO 13422 text; EO 14219 sec. 6(e) (Feb. 19, 2025) defines 'Regulation' to include any 'guidance document' 'as defined in Executive Order 13422', a borrowed definition inside a new order that does not revive EO 13422's commands (a definition-by-reference to a revoked order, noted). No amendment of 13422 between 2007 and 2009; nothing removed or ignored. Accept.

versions.research_rationale:
EO 13422 of January 18, 2007 consists of amendments to sections of Executive Order 12866, which remained in force as a separate order. Section 1 of EO 13497 of January 30, 2009 revokes EO 13422 and EO 13258 by number: "Executive Order 13258 of February 26, 2002, and Executive Order 
13422 of January 18, 2007, concerning regulatory planning and review, which 
amended Executive Order 12866 of September 30, 1993, are revoked." The held corpus contains no earlier revocation, supersession or amendment of EO 13422, and the order contains no sunset or report date. The dossier's whole-end conflict is resolved by identifying EO 13497, dated January 30, 2009, as the single actor of the first end; later orders that touch EO 12866 (the dossier lists EO 13777 and EO 14215) amend or concern that separate order and are not ends of EO 13422.
Member checks: {"earlier_end_check":"Own text: no sunset, expiry or report date; its operative provisions are amendments to Executive Order 12866. Searched held texts by the order's number: EO 13497 is the only instrument that revokes or supersedes it. No earlier revocation is held.","independent_command_check":"The order's commands are amendments to Executive Order 12866 plus ordinary general provisions; none is an independent continuing command that survived the revocation of EO 13422.","savings_check":"EO 13497 section 2 directs rescission of implementing policies and preserves none.","scope_check":"The inventory is the 31 scopes the packet derives from the Federal Register text of EO 13422; every scope is part of the single amending order and EO 13497 section 1 revokes the order as a whole."}

savings_residuals.reason: EO 13497 directs in its section 2 that implementing orders, rules, regulations, guidelines and policies be promptly rescinded to the extent consistent with law, and its section 3 creates no rights. It preserves nothing under EO 13422, and no continuing independent command is shown in the held texts.
